match.reason: No bank point covers digital health, online practitioners, app quality or privacy; the closest, Health literacy, only touches on judging online information and is narrower than this point, so a new point is needed.

draft.title: Digital health
card: Digital health uses websites, online practitioners and health apps. Examples are a telehealth video call with a doctor or an app that tracks sleep.
It can make information and care easier to reach. A person in a remote town can see a practitioner without long travel, and can look things up at any hour.
Quality varies. Some sites and apps use reliable evidence and others do not, so users should check who runs them and where the information comes from.
Privacy varies too. Apps and sites may collect, store or share personal data, so users should check how their information is used.
draft.remember: Digital health is easier to reach, but users must check its quality and privacy.

a.q: What is one benefit of digital health for a young person living far from a clinic?
opts: They can see a practitioner online without long travel
They can be sure every health website is accurate
They no longer need to give any personal information
They are guaranteed that apps never share their data
a.why: Online practitioners can be reached from home, which removes the need for long travel. Not every website is accurate, so the claim that all of them are is wrong.

b.q: Leila finds a free sleep app that asks for her name, location and contacts. What is the best thing for her to do before using it?
opts: Check how the app uses and shares her personal data
Trust it because it is free and easy to download
Trust it because many people have downloaded it
Give false details so the app cannot be accurate
b.why: Privacy varies between apps, so Leila should check how her data is used and shared. Being free or popular does not show that an app protects data or gives reliable advice.
b.clue: Privacy and quality vary from one app to another.

a.best: They can see a practitioner online without long travel

b.best: Check how the app uses and shares her personal data

problems.detail: The remember line says users 'must' check quality and privacy, but the card only says users 'should' check. 'Must' is stronger than the card.
